title: OpenVTON-Bench: A Large-Scale High-Resolution Benchmark for Controllable Virtual Try-On Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2601.22725v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly elevated the visual fidelity of Virtual Try-On (VTON) systems, yet reliable evaluation remains a persistent bottleneck. Traditional metrics struggle to quantify fine-grained texture details and semantic consistency, while existing datasets fail to meet commercial standards in scale and diversity. We present OpenVTON-Bench, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 100K high-resolution image pairs (up to $1536\times1536$). translated_title: OpenVTON-Bench：一个用于可控虚拟试穿评估的大规模高分辨率基准
translated_abstract: 扩散模型的最新进展显著提升了虚拟试穿（VTON）系统的视觉保真度，然而可靠的评估仍然是一个持续的瓶颈。传统指标难以量化细粒度的纹理细节和语义一致性，而现有数据集在规模和多样性方面无法满足商业标准。我们提出了OpenVTON-Bench，这是一个包含约10万对高分辨率图像（分辨率高达1536×1536）的大规模基准数据集。该数据集将基于Gemini的密集描述生成与通过DINOv3 K-Means聚类获得的20个视觉聚类上的分层采样相结合。为支持可靠评估，我们提出了一种多模态评估协议，从五个可解释的维度衡量VTON质量：背景一致性、身份保真度、纹理保真度、形状合理性和整体真实感。该协议将基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的语义推理与一种新颖的多尺度代表性评估方法相集成。
tldr: 该论文提出了OpenVTON-Bench，一个包含约10万对高分辨率图像的大规模虚拟试穿评估基准，通过结合VLM语义推理的多模态协议，从背景一致性、身份保真度等五个可解释维度实现可靠的虚拟试穿质量评估。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces OpenVTON-Bench, a large-scale benchmark of ~100K high-resolution image pairs for virtual try-on evaluation, featuring a multi-modal protocol that integrates VLM-based semantic reasoning to assess quality across five interpretable dimensions.
